project.name: treetracker-airflow-dags
project.description: Greenstand Apache Airflow pipeline that automates recurring Treetracker data jobs: exporting capture, grower and earnings data to CKAN and FTP, migrating legacy captures and stakeholders, computing reporting schemas and country leaderboards, precomputing web-map tiles and tree clusters, and running a SageMaker species-identification pipeline. Thin DAGs schedule work and delegate business logic to a shared lib of job modules over PostGIS/CKAN.

nodes.name: Data Export
nodes.summary: Extracts Treetracker records (tree captures, growers, earnings, planter info) from Postgres and publishes them to external destinations. Most exports stream batched query results into CSV and upload to the CKAN open-data portal; planter info uploads over FTP.

businessRules: Exports run per organization for a monthly date window
Inputs (organization id, date) are validated before any query runs
Query results are streamed in batches to bound memory usage
Planter info upload supports a dry-run mode that skips the FTP transfer
crossDomainInteractions: Shares month-range date helpers and Slack failure notifications with Platform & Orchestration
Reads capture and grower data produced by Data Migration

nodes.name: Data Migration
nodes.summary: Moves and reshapes legacy Treetracker data into the current domain database. Migrates legacy capture records daily and consolidates the stakeholder and entity tables, reconciling entity-stakeholder relationships transactionally.

businessRules: Capture migration runs on a daily schedule via Kubernetes pod operators
Entity-stakeholder reconciliation runs inside a single transaction with commit or rollback
The sync routine supports a dry-run mode
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies migrated captures consumed by Web-Map Precompute and Species Identification
Its entity and stakeholder sync logic is reused by Reporting & Analytics for FCC earnings

nodes.name: Reporting & Analytics
nodes.summary: Computes aggregates and denormalized reporting data in-database. Populates the reporting schema and tree_denormalized table, ranks countries by planted trees with PostGIS, computes FCC contract earnings per term, and chops sessions into time segments.

businessRules: Leaderboard ranking uses PostGIS spatial SQL (ST_Contains, ST_Area) over country geometries
FCC earnings are computed per contract term bounded by start and end dates
Reporting jobs compute results in-database rather than exporting raw data
crossDomainInteractions: FCC earnings reuse planter-entity population and entity-stakeholder sync from Data Migration
Uses shared utilities and failure notifications from Platform & Orchestration

nodes.name: Web-Map Precompute
nodes.summary: Keeps the Greenstand web map fast by precomputing tiles and tree clusters. Warms tile and cluster caches on a short schedule, assigns newly captured trees to clusters, removes deactivated trees, and refreshes webmap materialized views.

businessRules: Tile and cluster caches are warmed every 5 minutes for the most-visited views
Cluster assignment runs staged SQL within a transaction and rolls back on error
Deactivated trees are removed from cluster counts before views refresh
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes newly captured/migrated tree data from Data Migration
Cron shell wrappers in Platform & Orchestration run the Node precompute scripts outside Airflow

nodes.name: Species Identification
nodes.summary: Machine-learning pipeline that identifies tree species from capture images. Pulls capture image URLs within a geographic bounding box, stages images in S3, runs a SageMaker batch transform inference job, and builds a validation set from accepted predictions.

businessRules: Image URLs are selected by geographic bounding box and date range
Predictions are filtered by an acceptance threshold before entering the validation set
S3 staging buckets are cleaned up after each inference run
crossDomainInteractions: Reads capture image data sourced through Data Migration
Scheduled and error-notified through Platform & Orchestration

nodes.name: Platform & Orchestration
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting scheduling and platform jobs. Airflow default_args wire a shared Slack failure callback into every DAG, cron shell wrappers run Node jobs with PID locking, and small platform jobs provision messaging authors and wallet tokens.

businessRules: A task failure triggers a Slack notification via the shared on_failure_callback
Cron wrappers use a PID lock file to prevent overlapping runs
Messaging authors are created only for approved growers/organizations
crossDomainInteractions: Provides shared utils, date helpers and failure notifications used by all functional domains
Runs the Web-Map Precompute Node scripts as cron jobs

nodes.name: Monthly Capture Export
nodes.summary: Exports monthly tree-capture data for an organization to CSV and uploads it to the CKAN data portal.

nodes.name: Grower Export
nodes.summary: Queries grower records for an organization and date, builds a CSV payload, and uploads it to a CKAN datastore over HTTP.

nodes.name: Monthly Earnings Export
nodes.summary: Computes the previous-month window, queries earnings for that range, and pushes the dataset to a CKAN endpoint.

nodes.name: Planter Info FTP Upload
nodes.summary: Queries planter info from Postgres, builds a CSV byte stream, and uploads it to an FTP server on a daily schedule.

nodes.name: Migrate Captures
nodes.summary: Migrates legacy capture data into the new domain database daily using Postgres and Kubernetes pod operators.

nodes.name: Migrate Stakeholders
nodes.summary: Consolidates the stakeholder and entity tables and reconciles entity-stakeholder relationships transactionally.

nodes.name: Country Leaderboard Refresh
nodes.summary: Ranks countries by planted trees using PostGIS spatial SQL, fetches centroids, and persists the leader board back to the database.

nodes.name: FCC Contract Earnings
nodes.summary: Computes daily earnings for FCC (Freetown) planters by creating planter entities, syncing stakeholders, and aggregating contract earnings per term.

nodes.name: Populate Reports Schema
nodes.summary: Populates the reporting schema and the tree_denormalized table in Postgres via a sequence of SQL and Python tasks for downstream analytics.

nodes.name: Session Time Chopping
nodes.summary: Computes the session_segment for each raw_capture within a session and writes UUID-keyed segments to Postgres.

nodes.name: Reporting Card Cache Warming
nodes.summary: Pre-warms the reporting capture-statistics endpoint using the K8S_DOMAIN Airflow Variable and the current date.

nodes.name: Map Tile Cache Warming
nodes.summary: Pre-warms the web-map client tile cache for the most-visited views every five minutes by issuing GET requests over a fixed URL list.

nodes.name: Map Cluster Cache Warming
nodes.summary: Pre-warms map cluster tile endpoints across multiple zoom levels by repeatedly calling the pre_request helper.

nodes.name: Assign New Trees to Clusters
nodes.summary: Assigns newly captured active trees to their nearest map cluster by running staged SQL against Postgres within a transaction.

nodes.name: Update Clusters for Deactivated Trees
nodes.summary: Removes deactivated trees from cluster counts, refreshes the active_tree_region materialized view, and recomputes map clusters.

nodes.name: Refresh Webmap Materialized Views
nodes.summary: Refreshes the organization_location, planter_location, and species-statistics materialized views in the webmap database.

nodes.name: Species ID Batch Inference
nodes.summary: Runs the species-identification pipeline: selects capture images, stages them in S3, builds a manifest, runs a SageMaker batch transform job, and builds a validation set before cleaning up S3.

nodes.name: Task Failure Notification
nodes.summary: When any DAG task fails, the shared on_failure_callback builds task context and posts an alert to Slack.

nodes.name: Cron Wrapper Execution
nodes.summary: Shell cron wrappers acquire a PID lock to prevent overlapping runs, invoke a Node map task, and log output to a system log file.

nodes.name: Messaging Author Provisioning
nodes.summary: Hourly job that reads approved growers/organizations and inserts corresponding messaging-system author records.

nodes.name: Wallet Token Creation
nodes.summary: Creates wallet tokens by reading run configuration and inserting rows into the wallet database.

nodes.name: Trigger scheduled export
nodes.summary: The capture export DAG reads CKAN config from Airflow Variables, opens a PostgresHook connection, and runs the capture_export wrapper monthly.

nodes.name: Validate inputs
nodes.summary: Validates organization id and date parameters before any query runs.

nodes.name: Stream captures in batches
nodes.summary: Streams capture query results from Postgres in batches to bound memory usage.

nodes.name: Write CSV files
nodes.summary: Writes the batched rows to CSV files and renames the completed files.

nodes.name: Upload to CKAN
nodes.summary: Uploads the resulting CSV files to the CKAN dataset for the organization and date.

nodes.name: Trigger export
nodes.summary: The grower export DAG reads configuration from Airflow Variables and calls grower_export with a Postgres connection.

nodes.name: Validate parameters
nodes.summary: Validates parameters with a regex before running the export.

nodes.name: Query grower rows
nodes.summary: Queries grower rows for an organization and date from Postgres.

nodes.name: Assemble CSV
nodes.summary: Builds the CSV payload in memory via StringIO.

nodes.name: Upload to CKAN
nodes.summary: Posts the CSV to a CKAN resource via HTTP POST.

nodes.name: Trigger monthly export
nodes.summary: The earnings export DAG invokes the shared earning_export routine on a monthly schedule.

nodes.name: Compute previous-month window
nodes.summary: Computes the start and end date of the preceding month for the export window.

nodes.name: Query earnings for range
nodes.summary: Queries earnings for the given date range from the connection.

nodes.name: Push to CKAN
nodes.summary: Pushes the resulting earnings dataset to a CKAN endpoint.

nodes.name: Trigger daily upload
nodes.summary: The DAG wrapper opens a PostgresHook connection, reads FTP credentials from Airflow Variables, and delegates to upload_planter_info.

nodes.name: Query planter info
nodes.summary: Runs a SQL query against Postgres to fetch planter info rows.

nodes.name: Build CSV byte stream
nodes.summary: Encodes the result rows into a CSV byte stream via io.BytesIO.

nodes.name: Upload to FTP
nodes.summary: Uploads the generated CSV to the FTP host via storbinary unless dry_run is set.

nodes.name: Trigger daily migration
nodes.summary: The DAG schedules the capture migration daily using the with-DAG context and operator dependencies.

nodes.name: Run migration pod
nodes.summary: Executes the migration through a Kubernetes pod operator.

nodes.name: Load into domain database
nodes.summary: Loads the migrated legacy capture data into the new domain Postgres database.

nodes.name: Trigger migration
nodes.summary: The DAG orchestrates the migration using Postgres and Kubernetes pod operators.

nodes.name: Consolidate stakeholder and entity tables
nodes.summary: Consolidates the stakeholder and entity tables into the migration target.

nodes.name: Reconcile entity-stakeholders
nodes.summary: Detects and synchronizes stakeholder records against entities in a single transaction, committing on success or rolling back on failure.

nodes.name: Trigger scheduled refresh
nodes.summary: The DAG opens a PostgresHook connection and invokes refresh_country_leader_board on a schedule.

nodes.name: Rank countries with spatial SQL
nodes.summary: Runs PostGIS spatial aggregation SQL to rank countries by planted trees.

nodes.name: Fetch country centroids
nodes.summary: Fetches country centroids for the ranked results.

nodes.name: Persist leaderboard
nodes.summary: Serializes the leader board to JSON and upserts it into the leaderboard table via the connection.

nodes.name: Create planter entities
nodes.summary: Reads planter rows and inserts or updates corresponding entity records.

nodes.name: Sync entity-stakeholders
nodes.summary: Reconciles stakeholder records against entities inside a transaction.

nodes.name: Enumerate contract terms
nodes.summary: Enumerates contract terms and delegates each to the per-term earnings routine.

nodes.name: Compute term earnings
nodes.summary: Queries and writes FCC contract earnings for a single term bounded by start and end dates, committing through the shared connection.

nodes.name: Trigger schema population
nodes.summary: The DAG runs a sequence of SQL and Python tasks to populate the reporting schema in Postgres.

nodes.name: Run SQL and Python tasks
nodes.summary: Executes the chained SQL and Python tasks that build the reporting schema tables.

nodes.name: Populate tree_denormalized
nodes.summary: Populates the tree_denormalized table in the reporting schema for downstream analytics.

nodes.name: Read raw captures per session
nodes.summary: Reads the raw_capture rows for each session from Postgres.

nodes.name: Compute session segments
nodes.summary: Computes the session_segment for each raw_capture within a session.

nodes.name: Write UUID-keyed segments
nodes.summary: Writes the UUID-keyed session segments back to Postgres using the psycopg2 UUID adapter.

nodes.name: Build reporting endpoint URL
nodes.summary: Builds the reporting capture-statistics endpoint URL from the K8S_DOMAIN Airflow Variable and the current date.

nodes.name: Warm capture-stats endpoint
nodes.summary: Issues a GET request to pre-warm the reporting capture-statistics endpoint.

nodes.name: Schedule cache cycle
nodes.summary: The DAG runs the tile cache warming every five minutes for the top and per-organization pages.

nodes.name: Iterate tile URL list
nodes.summary: Iterates the fixed list of map client tile URLs to warm.

nodes.name: Warm tile cache
nodes.summary: Issues a GET against each URL to pre-warm the tile-server cache.

nodes.name: Schedule cluster warm
nodes.summary: The DAG invokes the cluster cache-warming helper on a schedule.

nodes.name: Iterate cluster URLs across zoom levels
nodes.summary: Iterates map cluster URLs at multiple zoom levels using a URL prefix.

nodes.name: Warm cluster cache
nodes.summary: Delegates each cluster URL to pre_request to warm the cluster cache.

nodes.name: Trigger cluster assignment
nodes.summary: The map DAG runs assign_new_trees_to_cluster on a schedule using a PostgresHook connection.

nodes.name: Run staged cluster SQL
nodes.summary: Runs staged SQL against Postgres to compute and persist cluster assignments for newly added trees.

nodes.name: Commit or rollback
nodes.summary: Manages transaction isolation and commits, rolling back on error.

nodes.name: Gate conf testing
nodes.summary: The conf-testing decorator gates the task callable to allow test overrides.

nodes.name: Refresh active_tree_region view
nodes.summary: Refreshes the active_tree_region materialized view after trees are deactivated.

nodes.name: Recompute clusters
nodes.summary: Recomputes map clusters and removes deactivated trees from cluster counts.

nodes.name: Refresh organization_location view
nodes.summary: Refreshes the organization_location materialized view in the webmap database.

nodes.name: Refresh planter_location view
nodes.summary: Refreshes the planter_location materialized view in the webmap database.

nodes.name: Refresh species statistics view
nodes.summary: Refreshes the species statistics materialized view in the webmap database.

nodes.name: Query capture image URLs
nodes.summary: Opens an SSH-tunneled SQLAlchemy connection to query capture image URLs within a geographic bounding box and date range.

nodes.name: Load images to S3
nodes.summary: Downloads capture images from their URLs and streams them into the inference S3 bucket.

nodes.name: Generate input manifest
nodes.summary: Builds a JSON-lines manifest of image URIs and uploads it to S3 for the batch transform job.

nodes.name: Trigger SageMaker inference
nodes.summary: Creates a SageMaker batch transform job against the model to run inference over the uploaded manifest.

nodes.name: Create validation set
nodes.summary: Reads inference responses, filters predictions by an acceptance threshold, and downloads accepted images into a local validation set.

nodes.name: Clean S3 buckets
nodes.summary: Deletes staged manifest and inference objects from S3 after the run completes.

nodes.name: Detect task failure
nodes.summary: The on_failure_callback wired into default_args fires when a DAG task fails.

nodes.name: Build failure context
nodes.summary: Builds the task context payload for the notification.

nodes.name: Post Slack message
nodes.summary: Posts the failure alert to a Slack channel.

nodes.name: Acquire PID lock
nodes.summary: Writes a PID file and uses an EXIT trap to enforce single-instance execution.

nodes.name: Invoke Node task
nodes.summary: Executes the corresponding Node map task once the lock is held.

nodes.name: Log output
nodes.summary: Logs the task output to a system log file.

nodes.name: Read approved organizations
nodes.summary: Reads approved growers and organizations from the database, honoring the organization filter toggle.

nodes.name: Insert author records
nodes.summary: Inserts corresponding messaging-system author rows via Postgres cursors.

nodes.name: Commit per batch
nodes.summary: Commits the inserted author records per batch.

nodes.name: Read run configuration
nodes.summary: Reads the token creation parameters from dag_run.conf.

nodes.name: Insert wallet tokens
nodes.summary: Inserts wallet token rows into the Postgres wallet database via PostgresHook.

edges.description: Cluster assignment consumes newly captured/migrated tree data from the domain database.
FCC contract earnings reuse planter-entity population and entity-stakeholder sync from the migration layer.
Species inference reads capture image data sourced through the capture data pipeline.
Export DAGs rely on shared date helpers and the Slack failure callback.
Node precompute scripts run through PID-locked cron wrappers outside Airflow.
